purpose: Teach: しだい/顔つき/過ぎ去っ/おねがい/ちがっ/あらわし/気が付く/どきどき

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんから連絡しだい、お知らせするわね
lines.en: Sho, I'll let you know as soon as your dad gets in touch, okay?
lines.style: Warm, reassuring tone. Gentle specificity—as if making a small promise she's capable of keeping. Patient pace. A mother's practiced calm that steadies a worried child.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんの顔つきが、ちょっと疲れて見えるよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad's face looks a little tired right now.
lines.style: Quiet observation. No judgment, just noticing—the perceptiveness of a child who watches carefully. Soft delivery, slightly tentative, as if checking whether what he sees is okay to say.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖父ちゃんの時代も、過ぎ去ってしまったわね
lines.en: Sho, Grandpa's time has passed now, hasn't it?
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly distant. Speaking more to herself than to him. A gentle sadness underneath. Slow, reflective pace. The kind of moment a parent has when a child's question opens up something bigger.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんにおねがいがあるよ
lines.en: Mom, I want to ask Dad something.
lines.style: Earnest, direct. Small voice, but steady intention. A six-year-old gathering courage. Slight pause before speaking, as if he's been holding this thought for a moment.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんとぼくの予定がちがっていたわよ
lines.en: Sho, it turns out your dad and you had different plans.
lines.style: Gentle explanation, not blame. As if explaining something small but real to him. Slight softness around the edges—acknowledging his disappointment without making it bigger than it is.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お絵描きで気持ちをあらわしたよ
lines.en: Mom, I showed how I feel through my drawing.
lines.style: Proud but not boastful. A child offering something he made with care. Slight lift in the delivery—wanting to be seen. Open, hopeful tone without being loud.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お母さんがおやつを冷蔵庫に入れたの、気が付くかしらね
lines.en: Sho, did you notice the snack I put in the fridge?
lines.style: Light, warm, a small turn toward gentleness. The tone of a mother offering something small and kind. Curious, gentle lilt at the end—inviting him to look, to notice, to feel seen.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、運動会の発表でどきどきしてるよ
lines.en: Mom, my heart is racing about my performance at the sports day.
lines.style: Trembling excitement underneath nervousness. Words come a little faster, breathiness around the edges. The flutter of a child wanting to share his big feeling but needing the safety of her listening.
